name: Deel
summary: Global payroll and workforce platform for distributed teams.
overview: Deel helps companies hire, pay, and manage workers across borders.
bull_case: Cross-border compliance is complex, creating durable demand for a unified platform.
bear_case: Local payroll incumbents and a slower hiring market could restrain growth.

intelligence.description: Deel provides global payroll, HR, compliance, and contractor-management software for distributed teams.
company: Deel helps companies hire, pay, and manage employees and contractors across jurisdictions through a payroll and compliance platform.
It raised $300 million in a Series E at a reported $17.3 billion post-money valuation in October 2025.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Deel is a major private-market benchmark for global HR infrastructure. Its scale tests whether global employment platforms can sustain durable enterprise economics as cross-border hiring matures.

changed.text: Raised $300M Series E at a reported $17.3B valuation.

takeaways: Deel is a core platform for global payroll and employment compliance.
The latest reported primary valuation is $17.3B.
Sustained growth and regulatory execution are central watch items.
